release_read.basis: Q3 XDEMVY net sales $194.6m (+64% YoY, +11.9% QoQ) beat the $183.9m Benzinga consensus by ~5.8%, refuting the Culper 'miss guidance' leg; H1+Q3 = $513.9m already makes the unchanged-looking $685-705m guide imply a Q4 decline, so the street's FY moves up. Tempered by no explicit guide raise in the release, a history of selling beats, and the Alkeus/PIPE unlock inside the window; EPS (-$14.40) is IPR&D-driven ($632m) and not the line.

release.headline: Tarsus Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results (8-K exhibit 99.1, dated 2026-11-03, GlobeNewswire; exact release time not stated, after the close ahead of the 16:30 ET call)

vs_bar.metric: XDEMVY net product sales (= total revenue)

vs_bar.consensus_source: Nasdaq EPS forecast carried in the brief (fallback); Benzinga snapshots -1.52/-1.71
vs_bar.note: Not comparable: includes $632.2m acquired IPR&D for iRenix and Alkeus; estimates did not carry the Alkeus charge. Not the line the stock trades on.

key_line.metric: Q3 XDEMVY net sales vs bar and implied FY
key_line.detail: $194.6m, +64% YoY, +11.9% QoQ from $173.9m; ~5.8% over consensus, a larger beat than Q2's ~4%. Nine-month sales $513.9m; the $685-705m FY guide would need only $171-191m in Q4, i.e. a sequential decline, so the guide is now visibly conservative. Also passed 1m bottles and $1bn cumulative sales. Cash $309.6m.

guidance.detail: The release text as fetched does not restate or raise the FY2026 XDEMVY guide ($685-705m, set at Q2); whether it was addressed on the call is not verified. Street expected a possible raise (Earnings Whispers called the guide conservative).

call.detail: Call was held last night at 16:30 ET per the release; no transcript or summary found in the time available, so tone, Q&A and any guide statement made only on the call are unknown.

public_reaction.summary: No analyst actions, price-target changes or post-release headlines found in one search; results surfaced were previews (Finviz, Earnings Whispers, which still listed a stale Nov 10 date). No retail tone read.

tape_read.note: Tape has no pre-market prints at all (prints 0, reference null, stale_at_open true) and the after-hours 'last' equals the prev close exactly (72.64), which reads as no after-hours bar rather than a flat reaction. So the market's reaction is unobservable here; labelled 'undershoot' only in the mechanical sense that nothing visible holds the +6% read. Position entered 73.60 vs prev close 72.64 (-1.3% at the close). Market risk-on: SPY +1.2%, IWM +1.8% pre-market.

thesis_check.note: Thesis was a modest revenue beat over a trend-based bar, with headroom from guide arithmetic, testing the Culper short. Beat was larger than the hunt's +2% print_vs_bar; guide not explicitly raised in the release; the Alkeus lock-up ending around today remains the offset.

expected.open_lag_note: No pre-market print exists to measure the open against, so p_open_lags is set at a coin flip as uncertainty, not direction. A clean ~6% revenue beat should gap the open up; amc gaps tend to give part back by 10:00, and the Alkeus/PIPE holders (~5m registered shares, PIPE cost $56) are natural sellers into a post-print bid today.

recommendation.reason: De omzet van XDEMVY (194,6 miljoen dollar) lag ruim 5% boven verwachting, dus de positie moet open hoger openen; dit is een cijfer na sluiting dat de hele nacht is gelezen. Er is geen voorbeurshandel te zien, dus we weten niet hoeveel al in de prijs zit, en vandaag komen aandelen van de Alkeus-overname en de PIPE vrij die verkocht kunnen worden. Daarom volgen we de vaste regel: verkopen op de opening.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als voor 09:30 actieve voorbeurshandel verschijnt die ver onder de 6% stijging blijft terwijl er koersdoelverhogingen of een verhoogde jaarprognose binnenkomen, dan is vasthouden tot 10:00 of de slotkoers te overwegen.
